package.name: go2_nav2_bridge
package.description: An autonomous, open-vocabulary Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pipeline for the Unitree Go2 EDU quadruped. Structurally decouples the heavy LLM intent reasoning layer from the deterministic real-time tracking loop, optimizing local GPU VRAM footprints and enabling low-latency physical navigation on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX.
